title: RentGuard Renters Policy Conditions — Returned Payments and the Discount Restart
content:
Restart dishonour points. Under the RentGuard Renters Policy, renters payments returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months reduce the discount percentages that apply after the multi-policy discount restarts.

**Condition.** When two or more renters payments were returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 2 points are subtracted from the discount percentages after the restart; when exactly one was returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 1 point is subtracted; when none was returned, none are subtracted.

**Records read.** The payment returned entries on the renters premium account, by the date each was posted, over the last 12 calendar months.

**Condition, judgement and result.**

| Condition on the renters premium account | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more payment returned entries posted in the last 12 calendar months | Two or more returns | 2 points subtracted |
| Exactly one payment returned entry posted in the last 12 calendar months | One return | 1 point subtracted |
| No payment returned entry posted in the last 12 calendar months | No return | 0 points subtracted |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A renters account with returns posted 4 months ago and 13 months ago counts one return in the window: 1 point is subtracted.
